name: legal-contract-analyzer
description: Legal Contract Analyzer - Research-Grade Legal Document Intelligence

scripts.dev: IF EXIST venv\Scripts\uvicorn.exe (venv\Scripts\uvicorn backend.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload) ELSE (uvicorn backend.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload)
scripts.start: IF EXIST venv\Scripts\uvicorn.exe (venv\Scripts\uvicorn backend.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000) ELSE (uvicorn backend.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000)
scripts.test: IF EXIST venv\Scripts\pytest.exe (venv\Scripts\pytest tests/ -v) ELSE (pytest tests/ -v)
scripts.reindex: IF EXIST venv\Scripts\python.exe (venv\Scripts\python scripts/reindex_contracts.py) ELSE (python scripts/reindex_contracts.py)
